commands.review_summary:
The branch adds a Slack Block Kit helper to drop duplicate OpenClaw reply-button action blocks and wires it into Slack outbound payload and reply block merging with one regression test.

PR surface: Source +54, Tests +49. Total +103 across 4 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: current Slack paths render presentation button blocks and legacy interactive button blocks separately, then concatenate them, so identical approval controls can appear twice. I did not run a live Slack repro in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The next action is contributor follow-up: add real behavior proof and cover the remaining Slack message-action send path before maintainer review can clear the PR.

target.title: Deduplicate mirrored Slack approval button rows
